entries.author: Italian Army (Esercito Italiano)
entries.note: Cavalry School, left front quarter: eight wheels in four evenly spaced pairs, the boat-shaped nose with its trim vane, the long low turret with a slab-sided bustle, the 120 mm gun with thermal sleeve and fume extractor, the commander's panoramic sight and remote station on the right of the roof, Italian three-tone camouflage.

entries.author: Italian Army (Esercito Italiano)
entries.note: Front quarter, close: the nose's lights and tow points, the driver's hatch on the left, the turret's front faces and smoke banks, the sights and antennas on the roof.

entries.author: Italian Army (Esercito Italiano)
entries.note: Low right front quarter: the black treaded tyres and hubs, the turret's side stowage boxes, the remote station's shape.

entries.author: Italian Army (Esercito Italiano)
entries.note: Left side in mud: hull length against the turret, the wheel spacing (a gap between the second and third axle), the gun's overhang.

entries.author: Italian Army (Esercito Italiano)
entries.note: Right side, near level: the hull side's plates and grilles over the rear wheels, the turret bustle's boxes and the gun's sleeve sections.

entries.author: Italian Army (Esercito Italiano)
entries.note: Head-on at a distance: the track width of the wheels, the hull's flared sides, the turret's frontal outline and the remote station on the right.

entries.author: Italian Army (Esercito Italiano)
entries.note: From above at the right rear while firing: the engine deck, the turret roof's hatches and sights, the bustle.

entries.author: Italian Army (Esercito Italiano)
entries.note: From above at the front: the glacis' panels, the turret roof, the commander's sight and the remote station.

gaps: europe_centauro_ii: no straight rear view; the rear plate and doors are read from the aerial rear quarter only

europe_centauro_ii: no source publishes the turret roof's height. The maker (IDV) gives 2.10 m to the hull roof and 3.65 m overall, over the roof's sights and remote station; the turret roof's 3.0 m is read from the photos (about 1.45 deck heights), as are the turret's length (about 0.6 of the hull's) and the gun's height (a little under halfway up the turret's side)
europe_centauro_ii: Italian three-tone camouflage as the photos show; the scheme is drawn as a printed recipe, not the photos' exact pattern
